prior_test_exposure: June 2026 has already been inspected. Further adaptive analyses are exploratory; independent confirmation requires new reserved data.
audit_scope: One seed per case, diagnostic only, no significance tests. The 100-unit control tests an already documented scarcity case; it is not a selected operating recommendation.

audit_boundary.observation: arrivals in [start,end); events at end included; pending and active retained

future_experiments.day_selection: Calendar-defined weekdays/weekend; evaluation is the first full seven days of June, already exposed and therefore exploratory.
future_experiments.ablation: v2 dispatch without relocation versus v2 dispatch with relocation
future_experiments.seed_rule: first_seed + replica_index, identical for compared policies; days treated as shared blocks
future_experiments.stopping_rule: Fixed 30 replications. Report achieved precision. Any budget revision must be versioned before evaluating v2 and cannot depend on favorable significance.
future_experiments.primary_outcome: traditional minus v2 mean response minutes for arrivals in the measured 24h window, with unresolved counts and response completeness reported
future_experiments.effect_direction: Time and unfinished: traditional minus predictive. Threshold achievement and completed: predictive minus traditional.
future_experiments.drain_rule: Stop arrivals at measurement end; allow in-flight and queued cases to finish up to cap. Freeze forecast at last available pre-cut hour for queued dispatch. Exclude warmup arrivals from response denominator; keep their workload.
future_experiments.censoring_rule: Report at-cut and post-drain completeness. If unresolved cases remain, complete-case response means are conditional and cannot alone establish superiority.
future_experiments.inference: Aggregate replications within day; retain pairing and temporal/day blocks. No incident-level IID inference. Existing 8C runs do not estimate confidence intervals.
future_experiments.multiplicity: Holm correction within the prespecified secondary comparison family; distinguish primary comparison from exploratory families.
future_experiments.model_selection: Use validation-selected frozen model; do not select on June test performance.
